region_mapping.binding: region geometry is stored in absolute source-page pixels
notes: changing the ROI re-binds regions; their page coordinates do not silently drift

weights.rule: w_raw = smooth rect * opacity; k = 1/max(1, sum raw); region = raw*k; base = 1 - sum(raw)*k
weights.grid_note: per-pixel weight grid omitted from the export; recompute it from regions, feather_px and the weight rule

g_7d39fab127ba8fa8.blend: reflect-pad FFT -> crop -> cosine feather to original at border
notes: Reflect padding supplies continuity; the mask is never applied to the unpadded array, so there is no circular wrap seam.
The outer 12 px ramp toward the original is an explicit, exportable compromise for boundary continuity.

processing_audit.note: Every group was filtered over the whole image; the composite is a normalized weighted blend. No region was filtered in isolation.

resample_audit.prefilter: exact fractional area box (per channel identical)
resample_audit.note: Area averaging is applied after screen suppression; it also prevents any leftover high frequency from aliasing into new moire.

resample_plan.reason: Suppression first removes the scanned screen; area resampling then prevents residual high frequency from aliasing into a new lower-frequency moire.

content_preservation.note: Retained fraction near 1.0 means content is preserved. Values below ~0.85 on edge/hairline metrics indicate over-smoothing.

peak_suppression.note: Reduction is the before/after ratio of a Hann-windowed DTFT evaluated at the exact detected screen frequency (matched filter), not the max of nearby FFT bins. 3 dB is the minimum meaningful drop; 12 dB indicates a clean notch. The conjugate amplitude is reported so a one-sided mask cannot pass.

boundary_continuity.note: For each region edge the processing delta's magnitude profile is measured along the edge. A smooth weight ramp yields a 10-90% transition comparable to feather_px; a per-block paste yields a one-pixel change and is flagged.

warnings: 50% of the crop is outside every zone and the base strength is 0, so that area is not filtered at all. Extend the zones or raise the base strength if it also carries a screen.
